crossRefs.note: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.
He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how…
Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,
lest Yahweh see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
“If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him
As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you. I haven’t desired the woeful day. You know. That which…
In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance, and foreigners…
For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so will all the nations drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow…
Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.

translations.web: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
translations.bsb: He who mocks the poor insults their Maker; whoever gloats over calamity will not go unpunished.
translations.kjv: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
translations.asv: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker; And he that is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
